szoveg_eredeti:
Kotoba , the leading voice AI lab in Japan, is joining ElevenLabs.

Together, we’ll bring Kotoba’s Japanese voice research to ElevenAgents, so more businesses can serve customers naturally in Japanese.

Welcome to ElevenLabs, Noriyuki Kojima , Jungo Kasai , and team.
